info.description: One format card shown in the FIA Rallycross Format section. Use a short label, title, explanation, and approved accent colour.

edit.description: Show this format card on the FIA Rallycross page.
Lower numbers appear first in the Format section.
Short card number or identifier, for example 01 or Heat 1.
Short format step title shown on the card.
One or two sentences explaining this format step to spectators.
Approved Motorsport accent colour used for the card label.
